behavior.backup: Browser-local account/workspace scoped name/timezone, baseline revision and uncertainty; no automatic server write
behavior.recovery: Explicit Recover/Discard after fresh authorized GET; stale/conflicted/unconfirmed backup requires field review before manual save
behavior.safety: Pending backup locks editing, successful save/discard/confirmed reload/sign-out clears it; failed read retains backup; same-browser other-user isolation

publication.required: Own exact final commit: three jobs/every required step and four artifact bytes/digests/CRC/reports
publication.finalReceipt: External ux01i-final-ci-receipt.json paired with source ZIP

limits: Browser storage may be disabled/cleared; local backup is not encrypted or a server/production backup
No automatic settings server save or merge; live/deployed/full-master acceptance open
